_comment: Two separate escape hatches for scripts/ci/check-definer-authorization.mjs. Read that file before adding to either. Both lists must only ever SHRINK.
_comment_reviewedExceptions: RULE 1, the writer rule. SECURITY DEFINER functions that WRITE, that a browser role can execute, and that do not consult auth.uid()/auth.role()/auth.jwt(). Each entry needs a reason that explains why a caller cannot point the function at anything that matters - not why it is inconvenient to fix.

reviewedExceptions.recalculate_leaderboard_ranks: Recomputes dense_rank() over scores that are already in promotion_leaderboards for one promotion. It reads no input beyond the promotion id, writes no new value, moves no money, and is idempotent, so the worst an attacker achieves is the correct answer. Caller: src/services/PromotionService.ts:365, immediately after the RLS-gated score upsert.

_comment_anonPublicSurface: RULE 2, the anon rule, added 2026-08-31 after THREE read-only SECURITY DEFINER functions arrived anon-executable in one afternoon and the writer rule cleared all three, because it only ever looked at functions that write. An entry here is a written decision that a caller WITH NO ACCOUNT may run this function. The reason must say what an unauthenticated caller is allowed to learn from it. If the answer involves schema shape, operator metrics, or another player's private state, it does not belong here - revoke it instead. Starts EMPTY on purpose: the rule only fires on functions a branch newly declares, so the existing public surface never needed grandfathering, and the first entry should cost somebody a paragraph of thought.

anonPublicSurface.fn_shared_bonus_replay: Public bonus replay links reveal only the immutable game/prize snapshot explicitly shared by its authenticated owner after settlement. The caller must possess a random share UUID; private entry IDs, identities, club data, wallet balances, seeds and unshared games are excluded. This read-only RPC never creates a share, publishes a post or changes a wallet.
anonPublicSurface.fn_platform_capabilities: Returns the public technical capability projection (id, rule version, title, scope, variants, compatibility, readiness, available). No evidence, actor, club, player or wallet data; read-only; capability readiness is not secret and the client gates product surfaces on it.

_comment_authenticatedAggregates: Rule 4 only: reviewed single-row aggregate declarations, pinned to SHA256 of comment-stripped header + NUL + body. PUBLIC and anon must remain denied. This is not an anonymous surface or a name-only exception; any declaration change requires renewed review and native qualification.

fn_smarter_poker_pulse_cron_counts.reason: Returns exactly one row containing only the existing pulse active home/pnm job count and the last-24-hour failure count. No names, commands, error text, users, financial records or product rows can be returned. The no-argument SQL STABLE body has no dynamic SQL or writes; authenticated/service grants are explicit and anonymous access is refused. Native PG17 qualifies count semantics and the real NOSUPERUSER BYPASSRLS owner boundary while the outer pulse retains caller RLS.
